@graph.name: OSDR Veggie Nutritional Analysis Dashboard & ML Pipeline
@graph.description: Machine learning analysis of nutritional composition in space-grown lettuce from NASA OSDR OSD-745. Includes elemental analysis (ICP-OES), phenolic content, anthocyanin content, ORAC antioxidant capacity, PCA, Random Forest classification, SHAP feature importance, and statistical testing.

@graph.name: Curated Nutritional Dataset
@graph.description: Harmonized dataset combining elemental composition, phenolic content, anthocyanin content, and ORAC values for all samples across 3 ISS Veggie missions.

@graph.name: Sample Metadata
@graph.description: Sample-level metadata including mission, condition, plant number, and harvest day.

@graph.name: ML Analysis Pipeline
@graph.description: Complete machine learning analysis: EDA, PCA, Random Forest classification, SHAP feature importance, regression, and statistical testing.

@graph.name: ML Results Summary
@graph.description: JSON export of all ML analysis results including PCA coordinates, feature importances, classification metrics, regression metrics, and statistical tests.

@graph.name: Interactive Dashboard
@graph.description: Static client-side web application for exploring nutritional data, images, and ML results. Deployable on GitHub Pages.

@graph.name: LaTeX Manuscript
@graph.description: Modular LaTeX manuscript with CoSE design system styling, compiling to PDF and DOCX.

@graph.name: Data Dictionary
@graph.description: Machine-readable schema documenting every column in the master CSV with data types, units, assay methods, and instrumentation.
